_note: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL on M1 Max 32GB. Dense hybrid model: 64 decoder layers (every 4th full attention = 16 attention layers, the rest Gated DeltaNet with fixed-size state) + 1 built-in MTP layer (blk.64). Sizes from the GGUF header (tools/gguf_meta.py): non-embedding tensors 15.89 GB (incl. the MTP layer), output head 1.043 GB. KV: 16 layers x 4 KV heads x 256 x (K+V) x 2 B (f16) = 65536 B/token. Bandwidth = measured MLX read (same machine as the Inkling run). MTP rows illustrative: acceptance unknown until measured; draft cost = MTP layer (~0.4 GB est.) + the shared LM head.
